ranking.entityReference: uid preferred; universityName allowed only during ingestion and must resolve uniquely at build/validation time

fields.rankingId: stable ranking series id, e.g. qs-wur / shanghairanking-bcur / the-wur / arwu
fields.edition: ranking edition, not necessarily publication calendar year
fields.rankLower: lower bound for a published rank band
fields.rankUpper: upper bound for a published rank band
fields.referenceRank: cross-category/reference rank supplied by the ranking body; never infer it from a category rank

admission.grain: one university × admission year × source province × exam scheme/subject group × batch × optional major/program

fields.examScheme: e.g. 文科/理科, 历史/物理, 3+3, 3+1+2
fields.subjectGroup: 科类/选科或院校专业组
fields.batch: actual admission batch for that province/year; 一本/二本仅作为历史事实，不作为学校固有属性
fields.minRank: 最低分对应位次 when officially published
fields.controlLine: 省控线/特殊类型线 when relevant
fields.sourceUrl: 省级考试院/学校招生网等来源

admission.rule: 录取分数线不能压成学校一个永久分值；跨省、跨年、跨选科比较必须先标准化为位次/分位数。

finance.grain: one university × fiscal year × statement type

fields.educationExpenditure: 教育相关支出 if published
fields.researchExpenditure: 科研相关支出 if published
fields.sourceUrl: 学校/主管部门官方公开预算决算

finance.rule: 预算、决算、收入、支出不是同一个概念；不在不同口径之间直接排名。
